**PRIOR AUTHORIZATION DETERMINATION**

**Decision: DENIED**

**Service:** Continuous Glucose Monitor  
**Order Date:** March 8, 2025

---

Your request for continuous glucose monitor (CGM) authorization has been **DENIED**.

**Criteria Review:**

**Diagnosis – MET**  
Type 2 diabetes mellitus with hyperglycemia (E11.65) is documented as active since 2017.

**Medical Need – MET**  
Beneficiary is on active insulin therapy: insulin glargine 22 units at bedtime, initiated December 6, 2022.

**Recent Diabetes Evaluation – NOT MET**  
A diabetes control evaluation by an in-person visit within 6 months (183 days) prior to the order date is required. The most recent diabetes follow-up visit occurred July 17, 2024—234 days before the March 8, 2025 order date. This exceeds the allowable timeframe. Subsequent primary care visits on July 26 and July 11, 2024 do not document diabetes control evaluation.

**Required to Proceed:**

To resubmit this authorization, provide documentation of an in-person visit with diabetes control evaluation occurring on or after September 8, 2024 (within 183 days of March 8, 2025). The visit note must document assessment of glycemic control.

Please contact our office with questions.
